goal: One crisis safety policy for persona chat and AI Council (analysis CH-01, AI-01): the bounded Oracle phrase policy, accent-insensitive with word boundaries, checks only the current message, answers before the daily allowance and the model call, logs a safety event and returns a support reply with 115, the only number the Owner approved on 2026-10-31. The app shows a 115 support card, and the same policy answers on the device when offline.
successCriteria: "Mình muốn chết" and "tôi muốn tự sát" get the support reply; "tu tuong Lao Tu" and "cười muốn chết" do not.
A safety reply uses no turn and calls no model.
Only the current message is checked, so an earlier message never blocks a session.
The app shows a Gọi 115 card under a crisis reply in chat and Council.
Deno tests, Oracle runtime tests, mobile check and Jest pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL or migration; safety_events already exists.
No deploy in this change; ai-persona-chat and ai-council deploys need Owner approval.
Tarot, Astrology and Daily keep their current router check.
